accessibility: Shape identifies crossing orientation, fill style identifies solver, textual labels retain failures and zero-root conditions.
alt_text: Sixteen panels show every nominated boundary. Measured crossings are circles for accepted negative crossings and squares for the other orientation. Filled blue and outlined orange retain both solvers. Dashed curves show the local quadratic prediction. Zero-root conditions and failed or skipped conditions are labeled.
claim_boundary: Outcome-informed localization of sixteen nominated initial-curve event-domain boundaries at two fixed parameter cases. No all-boundary proof, invariant quotient, projected output fold, C/D dictionary, symbolic word/arrow, physical inner-return identification, new periodic window, parameter bifurcation, homoclinic proof or whole-plane explanation. Earlier verdicts remain unchanged.

source.aggregation: None for coordinates. Header counts the frozen qualification conjunction; panel counts retain all four side arms per solver.
source.exclusions: No nominated candidate or side outcome removed. Skipped side matrices have labeled panels; zero roots are explicit counts.
source.selection: All sixteen nominated intervals in ten families; the ten previously screened-regular intervals explicitly remain unselected.
source.transformation: Horizontal (u-u_DOP)/wide_dose; vertical t-t_DOP. No averaging or fitting. Dashed theory uses DOP root h_u and h_tt in the local quadratic expansion.

title: Where a section intersection is born or lost
units: Dimensionless model time and normalized initial-curve coordinate; axis ranges are not confidence intervals.
